python3 << 'PYEOF'
import urllib.request, ssl, json, base64, re, sys
ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
token = 'ghs_hoY2PE2BDJPQYFUj8T7rm5nu9KrkWj3W1GFA'

# Get all files in backend/api from GitHub main
req = urllib.request.Request(
    'https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/git/trees/main?recursive=1',
    headers={'Authorization': f'token {token}', 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json'}
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx, timeout=30) as resp:
    d = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
    api_files = [item['path'] for item in d['tree'] if item['path'].startswith('backend/api/') and item['path'].endswith('.ts')]
    print(f"Found {len(api_files)} backend/api files")

corrupted = []
for path in api_files:
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            f'https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/contents/{path}?ref=main',
            headers={'Authorization': f'token {token}', 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json'}
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx, timeout=10) as resp:
            d = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
            b64 = d['content'].replace('\n', '')
            try:
                decoded = base64.b64decode(b64).decode('utf-8')
            except Exception:
                decoded = b64
            # Heuristic: is the decoded content itself base64-like? Starts with alphanumeric and looks like base64
            is_b64 = bool(re.match(r'^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{100,}', decoded[:200]))
            if is_b64 and not decoded.startswith('import'):
                corrupted.append({
                    'path': path,
                    'github_size': d.get('size'),
                    'decoded_prefix': decoded[:80],
                    'sha': d['sha']
                })
                print(f"CORRUPTED: {path} size={d.get('size')}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"ERROR checking {path}: {str(e)[:60]}")

print(f"\nTotal corrupted files: {len(corrupted)}")
for c in corrupted:
    print(f"  {c['path']}")
PYEOF

    'https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/git/commits',
    headers={'Authorization': f'token {token}', 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},

        'tree': new_tree_sha,
        'parents': [main_sha]
    }).encode(),
    method='POST'
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx, timeout=15) as resp:
    d = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
    new_commit_sha = d['sha']
    print(f"New commit SHA: {new_commit_sha}")

# Update branch
req = urllib.request.Request(
    f'https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/git/refs/heads/{branch_name}',
    headers={'Authorization': f'token {token}', 'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
    data=json.dumps({'sha': new_commit_sha, 'force': False}).encode(),
    method='PATCH'
)
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ctx, timeout=15) as resp:
    d = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
    print(f"Branch updated to: {d.get('object',{}).get('sha','')[:12]}")

print(f"\nReady to create PR from {branch_name}")
print(f"Commit: {new_commit_sha}")
PYEOF
